verdicts.reason: A blows the headline up so far that it wraps to 'Chase the / Light', a weak break that leaves 'Light' on its own line. The headline fills almost the full height, the CTA is jammed near the bottom edge with almost no margin, and the tiny logo floats in a large empty left area, so the banner looks cramped on one side and empty on the other. B is a proper left-to-right banner: logo on the left, and the headline and CTA kept on single lines with clear hierarchy. Its flaws are a logo that is a bit oversized and competes with the headline, and a text block that sits slightly tight to the right edge.
